name: codex
description: The window as the Codex app: a white page beside a soft gray sidebar, near-black type, no borders, big round corners, the chat as messages in a wide column with your prompt in a gray pill and a white composer with a soft shadow, unified diffs, a ring on a chat whose turn ended. Every New Tab asks what to build next and starts a Codex chat in the project you pick, the sidebar lists threads by project the way Codex does, and each chat's Session Info shows Codex's rate limits like /status. Shift-Command-O starts a Codex chat.
